description: A song in Smart Fade playback order, wrapping a standard Child. Both cue fields are present when analysis is available and omitted otherwise. Cues are fractional-second song positions, not fade durations; 0 <= fadeIn < fadeOut <= song length.

fadeIn.description: Suggested entry position in seconds from the song beginning. Zero for the first analyzed song.

fadeOut.description: Suggested end of the handover in seconds from the song beginning. The exact song length for the last analyzed song.
